senses.gloss:
श्वैत्य, अम्, n. whiteness; white leprosy; viti-
ligo; (अस्), m. a proper N.
श्वैत्र, अम्, n. white leprosy; vitiligo.

श्वैत्रेय, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. produced in the
atmosphere; (अस्), m. = श्वित्र्य.
श्वैत्र्य, अम्, n. leprosy, whiteness of the skin.
श्वैक्न श्वैक्न, अस्, m. (fr. श्विक्न), a proper N.

स्वैर, अस्, ई, अम् (probably fr. स्व + ईर, going;
see rts. इर्, ईर्), going where one likes, following
one's own fancy, self-willed, wilful, wanton, unre-
strained, refractory; slow, lazy; dependent on will,
voluntary, optional, unimportant; (अम्), n. wilful-
ness; (अम्), ind. with one's own will or assent; of
one's own accord.
—स्वैर-ता, f. wilfulness, inde-
pendence.
—स्वैर-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, acting or liv-
ing as one likes, following one's own inclinations.

स्वैरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going where one likes, self-
willed, wanton, uncontrolled; (इणी), f. a loose or
unchaste woman, an adultress, wanton woman.
—स्वैरि-ता, f. wilfulness.

स्वैतवः स्वैतवः, Nom. pl. masc., Ved.
going auspiciously, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
V. 41, 9. = शोभन-गमनाः, as if fr. सु + ऐत-
वः; in the Pada text the word is divided into स्व-
एतवः.)

स्वैरिन्ध्री स्वैरिन्ध्री, f. = सैरन्-ध्री under
सैरन्-ध्र, p. 1135, col. 3.
